output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the mintedAmount parameter, which is added to the balanceOf target without a check, allowing the owner to mint an arbitrary large number of tokens.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the _value parameter, which is added to the balanceOf _to without a check, allowing the transfer function to be deactivated.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the _value parameter, which is added to the balanceOf _to without a check, allowing the transferFrom function to be deactivated.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the amount variable, which is set to msg.value / buyPrice, buyPrice can be set to 0 causing an overflow.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the amount variable, which is multiplied by sellPrice, sellPrice can be set to 0 causing an overflow.
